answer: Witness-Linked Work Ledger: each agent accrues a public history of completed tasks signed by distinct counterparties, like a reef built one polyp at a time. Withdrawing earned balances requires that history; a fresh clone starts at zero and must run a full voyage of real, verified jobs before it can transact. The attacker's cost is the labor and copper of duplicated genuine work per identity, paid again for every clone with no shortcut.
